method: Complete 1-second contact-sheet visual review; 0.25-second review of 54:13-55:03 and 55:33-56:28. Timeout interior reviewed on 1-second sheets. Assistant-reviewed, not independently verified by a human coach.
definition: Visible live-ball field-goal attempts including blocked attempts; free throws excluded. Dead balls and non-shooting possessions are reviewed negatives.
split: expansion frozen before any algorithm run on this time range; same game as previous splits, NOT a new-game holdout

shots.note: 黑衣左侧进攻，右侧短距离跳投。
黑衣取得进攻篮板后运球，再次近筐出手；与前次跳投分开计数。
白衣转换推进后右篮突破上篮。

reviewedNegatives.note: 白衣罚球、黑衣取得球后推进；无运动战补篮。
白衣取得篮板后传球受干扰并重新控球；无新的朝篮筐出手。
暂停、球员近景、重返场地及黑衣底线发球准备。
黑衣底线发球受阻、停表及重新发球准备；不是罚球。
黑衣在后场接球摆脱防守，未见投篮。
